# DonorDock Pricing

DonorDock offers straightforward pricing for nonprofit organizations:

## Pricing Tiers

**Free Plan**
- Up to 500 contacts
- Basic donor management features
- Email support

**Growth Plan**
- **$39/month** (billed annually) or $49/month (billed monthly)
- Up to 2,500 contacts
- All core features included
- Email and chat support

**Professional Plan**
- **$99/month** (billed annually) or $119/month (billed monthly)
- Up to 10,000 contacts
- Advanced features
- Priority support

**Enterprise Plan**
- **Custom pricing**
- Unlimited contacts
- Custom features and integrations
- Dedicated support

## Key Features (typically included):
- Donor management and tracking
- Online donation processing
- Email campaigns
- Reporting and analytics
- Donation forms
- Mobile app access

## Notes:
- Pricing may vary based on contact count and specific needs
- Payment processing fees are typically separate
- Annual billing usually offers cost savings

**I recommend visiting [DonorDock's website](https://www.donordock.com/pricing) directly or contacting their sales team for the most current pricing and to discuss which plan fits your organization's needs best.**

*Note: Pricing information can change, so please verify current rates directly with DonorDock.*
